keep.quote: Some scientists think your brain guesses forward to cover the gap.
The fact, within two lines: a self-defeating prophecy, a prediction that prevents what it predicts because people act on it. The ghost is only ever a rumour about a world where you stood still.
The fact: a reward the brain fully predicted produces almost no response in its reward cells; the surprise is the signal.
